usedFor: Shopify holds your orders and Chatwork is where the team talks, so “Order Cancelled” runs “Send Message”.

bestTemplate.name: “Order Cancelled” in Shopify, then “Send Message” in Chatwork
bestTemplate.why: A cancelled order is posted to a group chat, so the team can act on it.

watchOut: “Abandoned Checkout” in Shopify is polling, so a message about it arrives after a scheduled check.
